name: typingease
description: TypingEase static site built with Eleventy templates and Vite.

scripts.build:clean: npm run clean && npm run build
scripts.check: npm run check:data && npm run test
scripts.check:data: node tooling/data/stamp-data.mjs --check && node tooling/data/sync-catalogue.mjs --check && node tooling/data/build-tasters.mjs --check && node tooling/data/build-course.js --check && node tooling/data/build-unit-symbols.js --check
scripts.test: node tooling/test/validate-lessons.js --quiet && node tooling/test/test-telex.js && node tooling/test/test-hangul.js && node tooling/test/check-words-en.js
